name: evidence-room
description: Evidence-linked submission review with an independent human scorecard.
author: Matthew Gaiser

scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && node scripts/dotnet.mjs build EvidenceRoom.sln --configuration Release
scripts.test: node scripts/dotnet.mjs test EvidenceRoom.sln --configuration Release && python -m unittest discover -s worker -p test_*.py
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e
